entry.title: Updated: dsh-mnemon
entry.summary: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI. Exact install spec: dsh-mnemon. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
